conflicts.permit: These cookies are used to collect information about how you interact with our website and allow us to remember you.
conflicts.prohibit: We won't track your information when you visit our site.
conflicts.situation: A user visits the Bizzabo website without choosing Accept or Decline.
conflicts.reason: The banner simultaneously asserts that cookies collect browsing interaction information and that the site will not track your information, without clearly conditioning tracking on acceptance.
